scripts.deploy:s3: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$AWS_S3_BUCKET --delete --cache-control public,max-age=31536000,immutable --exclude index.html && aws s3 cp dist/index.html s3://$AWS_S3_BUCKET/index.html --cache-control no-cache && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $AWS_CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID --paths '/*'
